from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    freq = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep = max((c for c in freq if c != bg), key=lambda c: freq[c])
    # Separator rows/columns have the separator color across most of their length.
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == sep for v in grid[r]) > w // 2]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h)) > h // 2]
    if len(hr) < 2 or len(vc) < 2:
        return [[bg]]
    # Collapse consecutive vertical boundary positions carrying the same data profile.
    profiles = [tuple(grid[r][c] for r in hr) for c in vc]
    tracks = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(vc):
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(vc) and profiles[j] == profiles[i]:
            j += 1
        p = profiles[i]
        if p[0] != sep and any(x != sep for x in p):
            tracks.append((i, p))
        i = j
    # Values persist into an output cell only when both bounding horizontal lines agree.
    out = [[bg] * max(1, 2 * len(tracks) - 1) for _ in range(len(hr) - 1)]
    for k, (pos, p) in enumerate(tracks):
        col = 2 * k
        for r in range(len(hr) - 1):
            if p[r] == p[r + 1]:
                out[r][col] = p[r]
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line = max((v for v in counts if v != background), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if sum(x == line for x in grid[r]) > w / 2]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h)) > h / 2]
    if len(hr) < 2 or not vc:
        return [[background]]
    # Each output column is represented by a duplicated pair of line intersections.
    profiles = [tuple(grid[r][c] for r in hr) for c in vc]
    channels = []
    last = None
    for profile in profiles:
        if all(x == line for x in profile):
            last = None
            continue
        if profile != last:
            channels.append(profile)
        last = profile
    # In these diagrams the two boundary crossings of a channel carry identical profiles.
    # Keep distinct channels in their left-to-right order, suppressing repeated copies.
    unique = []
    for p in channels:
        if not unique or p != unique[-1]:
            unique.append(p)
    out = [[background] * (2 * len(unique) - 1) for _ in range(len(hr) - 1)]
    for k, p in enumerate(unique):
        for r in range(len(hr) - 1):
            if p[r] == p[r + 1] and p[r] != line:
                out[r][2 * k] = p[r]
    return out
PY
